blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.
blocks.zh: 城市规模的3D地平面通常被表述为候选人排名,这需要预先计算的实例建议,并在大型户外场景中变得效率低下. 我们提议使用Urbex,这是一种代理式的视觉语言框架,它将地面定位为积极的空间搜索。 Urbex代表一个城市尺度的3D场景作为交互式多视图环境,允许一个VLM代理查询地标,放大到局部区域,渲染出oblique视图,并执行一个被禁入的边框. 我们优化了这项工具使用政策,在城市参考文献上进行强化学习,利用平稳的本地化奖励和轻量级塑造奖励来高效地探索。 实验显示,Urbex在City Refer上实现了最好的Hit@1和IoU,支持没有地上真人盒的无候选人地面,并且大大快于最强的城市规模排名基线. STPLS3D-Refer上的零镜头结果进一步表明跨场稳健性得到改进.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Grounding objects in 3D scenes from natural language descriptions ( Liu et al., 2025a ) is a core capability for embodied intelligence, with applications in autonomous driving ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) , robotic navigation ( Roh et al., 2022 ) , and aerial inspection ( Li et al., 2025b ) . While indoor 3D grounding has been extensively studied ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Achlioptas et al., 2020 ) , city-scale 3D grounding is still underexplored ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ) . Outdoor urban scenes are much larger than indoor scans, often containing hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of points per scene ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . The associated referring expressions are also more abstract, as a query may describe a small object through a named building, a road direction, or a distant landmark, e.g., “a white car parked next to the orange car to the left of the West Midlands Police Custody Suite.” Solving such queries requires both fine-grained visual recognition and reasoning over long-range spatial cues.

blocks.en:
Existing 3D grounding methods designed for indoor scenes ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) typically downsample raw point clouds to a fixed size, such as 50,000 points.
When applied to city-scale scenes, this strategy discards substantial fine-grained geometry and often leads to suboptimal performance, as illustrated in Figure 1 b.
To avoid processing the entire point cloud, recent city-scale methods instead formulate grounding as candidate ranking ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ) , as shown in Figure 1 c.
They first obtain object proposals from ground-truth annotations or an off-the-shelf instance segmentation pipeline ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) , and then compute text-instance matching scores for each candidate.
Although effective in reducing input scale, this formulation remains tightly coupled to precomputed candidates: its accuracy depends on proposal quality, while its inference cost grows with the number of candidates to be scored ( Luo et al., 2022 ) .
More importantly, it reduces grounding to a static retrieval problem, whereas localization in a vast urban environment is naturally sequential and exploratory ( Chaplot et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2019 ) .

在应用于城市尺度场景时,这一策略会丢弃大量精细的几何,并往往导致性能不尽人意,如图1b所示.
为了避免处理整点云,最近的城市尺度方法将确定为候选人排名(Miyanshi等,2023;Li等,2025a),如图1c所示。
他们首先通过地面真实说明或现成实例分解管道获取标的标的建议书(Jiang等,2020年),然后计算每个候选人的文本输入比对分.
虽然在减少投入规模方面很有效,但这种提法仍然与预选候选人紧密结合:其准确性取决于提案的质量,而其推论成本则随着拟得分的候选人数量而增加(Luo等,2022年)。
更重要的是,它把地基降低为静态取回问题,而地处广阔的城市环境中自然是相继的和探索性的(Chaplot等,2020;Chen等,2019)。

blocks.en: In this work, we instead formulate city-scale grounding as an active spatial search problem. Given a referring expression and an initial global observation, a model should parse the target attributes and spatial cues, choose where to inspect next, acquire new evidence, and decide when the evidence is sufficient to commit an answer. Recent tool-using language and vision-language agents ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ) provide a natural substrate for this formulation, as they can reason over visual observations and interact with external tools ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) . However, generic tool use is not sufficient. City-scale 3D grounding requires a task-specific interface that exposes the scene at the right level of abstraction, allowing the agent to move between global context and local detail without exhaustively enumerating all 3D instances.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们把城市规模的地平线确定为一个积极的空间搜索问题。 鉴于一种参考表达和初步的全球观测,模型应分析目标属性和空间提示,选择下一步检查的地点,获取新证据,并决定证据何时足以做出答复。 最近使用工具的语言和视觉语言代理人 (Bai等人,2025年;Achiam等人,2023年)为这种配方提供了天然的基质,因为它们能够通过视觉观察进行推理,并与外部工具相互作用(Yao等人,2023年;Schick等人,2023年;Ji等人,2026年)。 然而,一般工具的使用还不够。 城市规模的3D地平面需要一个任务特定界面,将场景暴露在正确的抽象水平上,使代理商可以在全球背景和当地细节之间移动而无需详尽地列举所有3D实例.

blocks.en: We propose Urbex, an agentic spatial grounding framework for city-scale 3D scenes. As illustrated in Figure 1 a, Urbex starts from a global bird’s-eye view (BEV), uses landmark queries to establish coarse spatial anchors, zooms into promising regions for fine-grained inspection, renders oblique views for 3D confirmation, and finally commits a box that is projected back to world coordinates. Urbex represents each scene as an interactive multi-view environment built around a BEV image and a consistent view-to-world coordinate mapping. The VLM reasons over the accumulated interaction history and either calls another tool or commits a final bounding box in a known BEV-aligned view. The system then projects the box back to world coordinates and evaluates it against the target instance. We train Urbex with reinforcement learning on CityRefer ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ) . The grounding episode is modeled as a multi-step decision process. A terminal reward encourages high overlap with the target and provides a dense center-distance signal when overlap is initially sparse. In addition, tool-level shaping rewards guide intermediate behavior, such as zooming toward the target region. This objective optimizes both final localization accuracy and the agent’s intermediate search policy. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose Urbex, an agentic framework that reformulates city-scale 3D grounding from exhaustive candidate ranking to active spatial search. • We design a city-aware interactive tool interface that enables a VLM agent to search large urban scenes through landmark querying, local zooming, and oblique-view verification, and optimize this multi-step policy with reinforcement learning. • Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, substantially improves online inference efficiency over the strongest ranking baseline, and demonstrates strong zero-shot robustness on STPLS3D-Refer.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D Scene Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维场景

blocks.en: 3D scene grounding aims to localize a specific object within a 3D environment based on a natural-language referring expression. A large body of prior work has predominantly focused on indoor scenes, where early methods typically encode entire point clouds or multi-view images, fuse them with a language encoder, and rank candidate instances via cross-modal matching ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Achlioptas et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2022 ) . Subsequent research has significantly advanced this paradigm by incorporating relation modeling, multi-view context, and transformer-based architectures ( Yuan et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , and exploring proposal-free, bottom-up localization to avoid error accumulation from segmentation models ( Luo et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2022b ) . Recent zero-shot and open-world methods further exploit foundation models, scene parsing, multi-view reasoning, or scene graphs to reduce dependence on task-specific supervised training ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . These methods are highly relevant to the goal of reducing proposal dependence, but they are primarily designed for indoor or object-centric 3D scenes and do not directly address city-scale landmark reasoning, very large search spaces, or online efficiency over dense urban instances.
blocks.zh: 3D场景地平面以基于自然语言引用表达方式的3D环境中的特定对象定位为目的. 以前大量的工作主要集中在室内场景上,早期的方法通常将整个点云或多视图图像编码,使其与语言编码器相接,并通过跨模式匹配对候选实例进行排序(Chen等,2020;Achlioptas等,2020;Huang等,2022)。 随后的研究大大地推进了这一范式,将关系模型,多视角背景,变相器等建筑(袁等,2021;吴等,2023;探索无提案自下而上本地化,避免从分化模型中积累出错(罗等,2022;陈等,2022b. 近期的"零射"和"开放世界"方法进一步利用地基模型,场景剖析,多景推理,或场景图来减少对特定任务监督训练的依赖(黄等,2025;刘等,2025b;张等,2026;顾等,2024). 这些方法与降低提案依赖性的目标高度相关,但它们主要针对室内或以物体为中心的3D场景而设计,并不直接针对城市规模地标推理,非常大的搜索空间,或针对密集的城市案例的在线效率.

blocks.en: City-scale 3D grounding presents challenges that are substantially different from those in indoor scenes. Outdoor urban environments cover much larger spatial extents, contain many repetitive instances such as vehicles and buildings, and often require reasoning over long-range spatial cues and named landmarks. As a result, existing city-scale methods typically adopt a static candidate-ranking pipeline, where instance boxes are obtained in advance, multimodal features are extracted offline, and a scoring model ranks all candidates during inference ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . Although this formulation avoids directly processing the entire city-scale point cloud, it remains constrained by the quality of precomputed proposals, requires costly feature preprocessing, and becomes inefficient when many candidates must be scored. More importantly, it treats localization as a one-shot retrieval problem. In contrast, Urbex frames city-scale grounding as sequential spatial interaction, actively searching the scene through a small number of targeted observations.
blocks.zh: 城市规模的三维地平地作业提出了与室内场景相比有很大不同的挑战。 户外城市环境覆盖了更广阔的空间范围,包含车辆和建筑物等多起重复事件,并且往往需要对长距离空间提示和被命名地标进行推理. 因此,现有的城市规模方法通常采用静态候选人排位式管道,其中先取实例框,取出多模式特征下线,评分模型在推论中排出所有候选人(Miyanshi等,2023;Li等,2025a.). 虽然这种配方避免了直接处理整个城市尺度分数云,但是它仍然受到被预估的建议书质量的限制,需要昂贵的特征预处理,当许多候选人必须得分时就会变得效率低下. 更重要的是,它把本地化视为一发取回问题. 相比之下,Urbex将城市规模定位作为相继的空间互动,通过少量定向观测积极搜索现场.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agentic Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理远景-语言模型

blocks.en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in visual question answering, fine-grained reasoning, and instruction following ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Chu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ) . RL further improves reasoning capabilities ( Chu et al., 2026 ) . Building upon these foundation models, recent research has evolved from passive perception to active, agentic systems capable of calling tools, manipulating graphical interfaces, and interpreting complex visual environments ( Surís et al., 2023 ; Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) . Instead of outputting a single-pass prediction, such agentic frameworks interact with their surroundings through a continuous loop of observation, reasoning, action, and feedback ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 现代视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉问题回答,精细推理,以及后续指导方面表现出了超乎寻常的能力(郑等,2026;刘等. 2023; Chu等,2024; Bai等,2025; Achiam等,2023; RL进一步提高了推理能力(Chu等,2026. 以这些基础模型为基础,最近的研究从被动感知演变为能调用工具、操纵图形界面和解释复杂视觉环境的活性代理系统(Surís等,2023;Gupta和Kembhavi,2023;Kembhavi), 2023; 谢等, 2024; 姬等, 2026). 这种活性框架没有输出出单行道预测,而是通过连续循环的观察、推理、行动和反馈与其周围环境相互作用(姚等,2023;史克等,2023;马等,2026;袁等,2026;王等,2026c;王等,2026b.).

blocks.en: However, much of the agentic VLM literature focuses either on 2D tasks, such as web navigation and open-ended image reasoning, or on indoor embodied navigation ( Ma et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Recent work has begun to formulate 3D grounding itself as an agentic or sequential process, including dynamic 2D-to-3D reconstruction with visual tools ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , active cognition over open-world object lookup structures ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , graph-guided VLM reasoning over 3D scene structure ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , and task-oriented sequential grounding in indoor scenes ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . While conceptually close to our active-search view, these works operate in indoor RGB-D or graph-structured settings and are not optimized for city-scale 3D environments. Urbex specializes the agentic VLM paradigm for this challenging domain by providing city-aware spatial tools and an RL objective tailored for efficient exploration.
blocks.zh: 然而,许多代理VLM文献要么侧重于2D任务,如网络导航和可自由限定的图像推理,要么侧重于室内所体现导航(Ma等,2023;Huang等,2024.). 近期工作开始将3D定位定位定位为代理或相继过程,包括动态2D-至相继重建可视化工具(王等,2026a),活性认知开放世界物体取景结构(黄等,2025),图导VLM推理可视3D场景结构(刘等,2025b),任务导向相继定位室内场景(张等,2024). 这些作品虽然在概念上接近于我们的活性搜索视角,但在室内的RGB-D或图形结构的设置中运行,并没有被优化用于城市规模的3D环境. Urbex通过提供具有城市意识的空间工具和适合高效探索的RL目标,专门为这一具有挑战性的领域制定代理VLM范式.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Urbex formulates city-scale 3D grounding as active spatial search rather than static candidate retrieval. The central design choice is to expose a large 3D scene through a small number of coordinate-aligned visual observations that a VLM can inspect and act upon. We first describe how the environment converts city-scale geometry into a VLM-operable multi-view space, then define the tool-use reasoning loop over these views, and finally present the reinforcement learning objective that turns prompted tool use into a learned search policy.
blocks.zh: Urbex将城市规模的3D地平面设定为主动空间搜索而非静态候选检索. 中央设计选择是通过少量坐标相通的视觉观测来曝光一个大的3D场景,一个VLM可以检查并采取行动. 我们首先描述了环境如何将城市尺度几何转换成一个可操作的VLM多视图空间,然后在这些视图上定义工具-使用推理循环,最后提出强化的学习目标,将所激发的工具使用转化为已学到的搜索政策.

blocks.en: 3.1 Interactive environment for city-scale 3D grounding
blocks.zh: 3.1 城市规模三维地面的互动环境

blocks.en: Given a city-scale 3D scene 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and a natural-language query q q , the goal is to localize the referred object o ⋆ o^{\star} and output its spatial extent. A conventional candidate-ranking method assumes a candidate set 𝒞 = { o i } i = 1 N \mathcal{C}=\{o_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} and learns a score s ⁡ ( q , o i ) s(q,o_{i}) for each candidate, making the quality and size of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} central to both accuracy and efficiency ( Li et al., 2025a ; Miyanishi et al., 2023 ) . In contrast, Urbex receives no candidate set and exposes the scene through views 𝒱 \mathcal{V} that the agent can extend through tool calls. It predicts a free-form box b ^ v \hat{b}_{v} in a known BEV-aligned view v v , which the environment maps to a world-space extent. Ground-truth boxes provide training rewards and evaluation targets, but are not inference inputs.

blocks.en: The environment provides three complementary tools for global anchoring, local detail recovery, and 3D verification, keeping the action space compact. Landmark Query resolves a named landmark from the query, such as a building or road name, and returns its world position and its projection in a selected view. This tool provides global spatial anchors when the expression contains proper nouns. This design is motivated by the geography-aware nature of city-scale referring expressions, where named buildings, roads, and other landmarks provide strong global anchors ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ; OpenStreetMap contributors, 2026 ) . Zoom-in maps a selected box to the original high-resolution BEV and returns a local crop with a new view identifier and transform. The original BEV has a long side typically exceeding 10,000 pixels, so cropping recovers genuine detail absent from the downsampled global observation, where small objects occupy only a few pixels. Oblique Rendering renders a selected candidate region from a specified cardinal direction, producing a 3D-aware view that helps verify object shape, height, and spatial placement. The oblique image is used as supporting evidence rather than as the coordinate frame for the final submission. Detailed tool definitions and argument schemas are provided in Table 5 .

blocks.en: The resulting inference procedure naturally decomposes into global search, local observation, and candidate confirmation. The agent first parses the expression to identify target attributes and spatial anchors in the BEV, then zooms into promising regions to resolve small objects or dense local context, and finally renders oblique views when top-down evidence is insufficient to verify the 3D object. Because every tool response is appended to the interaction history, the model can refer back to previous views and maintain coordinate consistency while switching between global and local evidence. This protocol can be used directly with a prompted VLM, yielding a zero-shot tool-use baseline, but the search space remains large. The model must learn not only how to interpret each view, but also when to query, zoom, render, or stop, which motivates the RL training described next.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的推论程序自然会分解成全球搜索、局部观察和候选人确认。 该剂首先剖析出表达式,以识别BEV中的目标属性和空间锚地,再放大到有希望的区域来解决小物体或密集的局部上下文,最后当自上而下的证据不足以验证出3D物体时会形成偏斜视图. 由于每个工具响应都附加在交互历史中,模型可以追溯到以前的观点并保持协调一致性,同时切换全球和本地证据. 这个协议可以用被激发的VLM直接使用,产生零射入的工具使用基线,但搜索空间仍然很大. 该模型不仅必须学会如何解释每个视图,而且还必须学会何时进行查询、放大、渲染或停止,这将激励接下来所述的RL培训。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluate Urbex along three axes, namely in-domain performance, cross-scene generalization, and component sensitivity. CityRefer ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ) is used as the main benchmark for comparing grounding accuracy and inference efficiency, while STPLS3D-Refer, our evaluation set constructed from STPLS3D ( Chen et al., 2022a ) , tests whether the learned policy transfers to scenes with different geometry and visual appearance. We convert both datasets into the same BEV-based interactive environment and use the same action protocol and evaluation code for all tool-using models. Detailed dataset statistics are provided in Appendix B , while training and inference protocols, hyperparameters, and other implementation details are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们沿着三个轴线来评价Urbex, 即域内性能, 跨地性通化,和组件敏感性. City Refer(Miyanishi等,2023年)被用作比较地平分精度和推论效率的主要基准,而STPLS3D-Refer,我们的评价集由STPLS3D(Chen等,2022a)构建,测试所学的政策是否转移到了具有不同几何和视觉外观的场景. 我们把两个数据集转换成相同的基于BEV的互动环境,对所有使用工具的模型使用相同的动作协议和评价代码. 附录B提供了详细的数据集统计数据,附录A提供了培训和推论协议、超参数和其他实施细节。

blocks.en: We compare three groups of methods that stress different aspects of the problem. General-purpose multimodal models, including GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.6-plus, provide strong visual reasoning priors. We connect them to the same Urbex tool environment to test whether a powerful off-the-shelf VLM can solve the task through prompting alone, without task-specific policy optimization. Indoor 3D grounding methods reveal two different failure modes when moved to city-scale scenes. EDA follows the common indoor practice of processing a downsampled point cloud, which discards much of the fine-grained geometry needed for small urban objects ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . InstanceRefer instead operates in a candidate-ranking setting with provided instances, which is easier than direct full-scene localization and therefore performs more reasonably than dense point-cloud grounding methods ( Yuan et al., 2021 ) . City-scale methods such as CityRefer and CityAnchor are closer to our setting, but they still primarily rely on ranking precomputed candidates rather than actively searching the scene ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . Details on each baseline implementation are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三组强调问题不同方面的方法。 通用多式模型,包括GPT-5.4和Qune3.6-plus,提供了强大的视觉推理前作. 我们把它们连接到相同的Urbex工具环境,以测试一个强大的现成的VLM是否能够单独地通过提示来解决任务,而无需针对特定任务的政策优化. 室内3D地平面方法在移动到城市尺度场景时揭示出两种不同的故障模式. EDA遵循了处理被下取样的点云的常见室内做法,它抛弃了城市小物体所需的许多精细几何(Wu等,2023年). 相反,参考案例是在有规定实例的候任环境中运作的,这比直接全场本地化容易,因此比密集点云地平地方法更合理(袁等,2021年)。 City Refer和CityAnchor等城市尺度方法更接近于我们的设定,但它们仍然主要依靠排名预选候选人,而不是积极搜索现场(Miyanshi等,2023;Li等,2025a.). 附录A.3提供了每项基准执行情况的详细情况。

blocks.en: We report results on the novel description (ND) and novel object (NO) splits: ND uses unseen descriptions in scenes observed during training, while NO uses targets from held-out scenes that do not appear in training. In With GT , candidate-ranking baselines may use the ground-truth candidate instance set and are evaluated with Hit@1, Hit@3, and Hit@5. Urbex does not use candidate boxes during inference even in this setting; it always outputs a free-form BEV box, which is matched to candidates only after prediction: candidates are ranked by 2D IoU with the predicted box, and Hit@ k k records whether the target is among the top k k , without a minimum overlap requirement. This measures target identification; thresholded Hit@1 and direct overlap metrics additionally assess box quality (Appendix D.5 ). In Without GT , methods cannot access ground-truth candidate boxes and must directly output a spatial prediction; we therefore report 2D IoU, 3D IoU, and point-level F1 against the target. This setting is closer to deployment, where complete and accurate instance boundaries are rarely available. Rows whose metrics would all be inapplicable are omitted from the corresponding subtable; otherwise inapplicable cells are marked as New A. GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.6-plus do not expose comparable timing measurements, while InstanceRefer, CityRefer, and CityAnchor require candidate instances; we separately test CityAnchor with predicted proposals in Appendix D.4 . Accuracy metrics are percentages. We report inference time per example on a single GPU, including model generation and online tool execution, while excluding offline scene preparation and cached rendering construction for all methods.
blocks.zh: 我们报告关于小说描述(ND)和小说对象(NO)的分出结果:ND在训练期间观察到的场景中使用了看不见的描述,而NO则使用不出现在训练中的被搁置场景中的目标. 在GT中,候选人排名的基线可能使用地面真实候选人实例集,并以Hit@1、Hit@3和Hit@5来评价。 Urbex在推论期间甚至在此设置中也不使用候选框;它总是输出一个自由形态的BEV框,只有在预测后才会与候选框相匹配:候选框由2D IoU与预测框排出,而Hit@k记录目标是否在最高的k k中,没有最小的重叠要求. 这一措施旨在确定目标;设定阈值的Hit@1和直接重叠的度量标准额外评估了框质量(附录D.5)。 在没有GT的情况下,方法不能访问地真候选框,必须直接输出空间预测;因此,我们报告2D IoU,3D IoU,以及点级F1对目标. 这种设置更接近于部署,因为在那里很少有完整和准确的实例边界。 相应的子表中省略了其所有标准不适用的行;否则不适用的单元格被标记为新A. GPT-5.4和Qune3.6-plus,不显示可比较的计时标准,而EctoryRefer、CityRefer和CityAnchor则需要候选实例;我们在附录D.4中分别测试CityAnchor和预测提案。 精确度指标为百分比。 我们报告单个GPU的推断时间,包括模型生成和在线工具执行,同时排除了所有方法的离线场景准备和缓存渲染构造.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results on CityRefer
blocks.zh: 4.2 关于城市参考的主要结果

blocks.en: Table 1 : Main results on CityRefer. Urbex supports candidate-free grounding and efficient inference. Five-run Hit@1 statistics are reported in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 表1:城市参考资料的主要结果。 Urbex支持无候选人地基和高效推论. 五跑点击数@1统计见表8。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the main CityRefer results. GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.6-plus obtain non-trivial accuracy after being connected to the Urbex tool environment, showing that strong VLMs can exploit the interactive views and tool feedback to perform partial active search. However, their performance remains far below Urbex, showing that these prompted tool-use baselines do not recover the accuracy of the trained policy. The indoor baselines illustrate why directly transferring indoor 3D grounding pipelines is also insufficient. EDA almost fails on both splits, consistent with the severe information loss caused by downsampling city-scale point clouds before grounding. InstanceRefer performs better because it is evaluated as a simpler candidate-ranking problem with provided instances, but it still remains far below city-scale methods and cannot directly solve candidate-free localization.
blocks.zh: 表1报告主要城市参考结果。 GPT-5.4和Qwen3.6-plus在被连接到Urbex工具环境后获得非三角精度,显示强VLM可以利用交互视图和工具反馈进行部分活性搜索. 然而,它们的性能仍然远远低于Urbex,表明这些诱发的工具使用基线无法恢复训练有素政策的准确性. 室内基线说明为何直接转移室内立体地面管线也不足。 EDA几乎在两个分块上都失败了,这与在倒地前进行城市标分云的下取样所造成的严重信息损失是一致的. 案例参考书的成绩更好,因为它被评价为一个比较简单的候选人排位问题,只要提供了实例,但它仍然远远低于城市规模方法,无法直接解决无候选人本地化问题。

blocks.en: Among city-scale baselines, CityRefer is limited when evaluated as a full ranking problem because its original setting assumes that the target appears in a small 10-instance candidate pool rather than requiring discrimination over all scene instances ( Miyanishi et al., 2023 ) . CityAnchor is much stronger because it scores candidates with multimodal large language models, but this design requires applying the scoring model to many instances and therefore incurs high inference cost. In the With-GT setting, Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and Hit@3 on both test splits and the best Hit@5 on NO. CityAnchor retains the highest Hit@5 on ND: exhaustive ranking can retain several plausible GT candidates, including a target that Urbex misses during regional search or confuses with a local distractor. Thus, broader candidate recall and precise single-box search have different failure modes (Appendix D.6 ).
blocks.zh: 在城市规模的基线中,City Refer作为一个完全排位问题被评价时是有限的,因为其最初设定假设目标出现在一个小型的10英寸候选集合中,而不是要求在所有场景中实行歧视(Miyanshi等,2023年). CityAnchor更强大,因为它以多式大型语言模型对考生进行评分,但这种设计需要将评分模型应用到很多情况下,因此产生高昂的推论成本. 在With-GT设置中,Urbex在两个测试分出时都实现了最佳Hit@1和Hit@3,在NO上实现了最佳Hit@5. CityAnchor在ND上保留了最高的Hit@5:详尽的排名可以保留几个可信的GT候选人,包括Urbex在区域搜索中错过的目标或与本地分心器相混淆. 因此,更广泛的候选人召回和精确的单框搜索有不同的失败模式(Appendix D.6.

blocks.en: The advantage becomes clearer in the Without-GT setting, where candidate-ranking methods require a proposal-generation stage. General multimodal models can use the same prompted tool interface, but their 2D and 3D IoU remain substantially lower than Urbex. To test a complete proposal-based pipeline, we train SoftGroup ( Vu et al., 2022 ) on 15 non-CityRefer SensatUrban scenes and supply its proposals to CityAnchor. On NO, this pipeline reaches 4.2/2.4/4.7 in BEV IoU/3D IoU/point F1, versus 14.6/7.7/17.8 for Urbex (Appendix D.4 ), showing the practical gap for this proposal-based pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在 " 无GT " 环境中,这种优势变得更加明显,在这种环境中,按候选人排序的方法需要形成提案的阶段。 一般多式模型可以使用相同的被激发的工具接口,但其2D和3D IoU仍然大大低于Urbex. 为了测试一个完整的基于建议书的管道,我们用15个非City Refer SensatUrban场景来训练SoftGroup(Vu等,2022年),并向CityAnchor提供其建议书. 在NO方面,这一管道在BEV IoU/3D IoU/Point F1中达到4.2/2.4/4.7,而在Urbex(附录D.4)中则达到14.6/7.7/17.8,这表明了这一基于提案的管道的实际缺口。

blocks.en: Urbex is also substantially more efficient than the strongest ranking baseline under the online timing protocol above. CityAnchor, the second-best-performing method in the With-GT comparison, requires about 32.1 32.1 seconds per example because it scores many candidate instances, whereas Urbex takes about 3.2 3.2 seconds. This amounts to an order-of-magnitude inference-speed improvement, since Urbex inspects a small number of informative regions rather than exhaustively scoring all instances. The tools account for about 0.36 s/query. Building the optional oblique cache takes approximately 2.3 hours across 12 CityRefer scenes; rendering on demand instead gives an estimated 4.4 s/query ( 7.3 × 7.3\times faster). These comparisons exclude offline scene preparation; Appendix D.7 separates the measured cache cost from other, unmeasured preparation components.

blocks.en: 4.3 Zero-shot generalization on STPLS3D-Refer
blocks.zh: 4.3 STPLS3D-Refer上的零射通论

blocks.en: We next evaluate zero-shot transfer to STPLS3D-Refer. The agent is trained only on CityRefer and is directly applied to STPLS3D-Refer after converting scenes into the same BEV-based interactive environment. This setting tests whether the model has learned a reusable spatial search strategy rather than a dataset-specific ranking function. As shown in Table 2 , the new scenes are challenging for all compared methods: indoor grounding methods are sensitive to domain shift, and city-scale ranking models degrade when candidate distributions and visual statistics differ from CityRefer. GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.6-plus perform reasonably well after being connected to the Urbex tool environment, again showing that strong VLM reasoning can exploit interactive observations even without task-specific training. However, Urbex achieves the best score on every reported accuracy metric. These aggregate results suggest, but do not by themselves prove, that the RL-trained policy learns reusable search behaviors such as anchoring, zooming, verifying, and stopping. To examine transfer beyond named geographic anchors, we additionally evaluate 30 manually verified landmark-free re-annotations of STPLS3D-Refer. Without further training, Urbex achieves 23.3 Hit@1 on these expressions, providing complementary evidence that the learned policy transfers to queries expressed through visual attributes and local spatial relations. Appendix D.3 details this evaluation and the landmark-robustness experiments; Figure 4 illustrates the agent’s spatial search and grounding trajectories in the new scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评价零发转录到STPLS3D-Refer. 该代理只在City Refer上被培训,在将场景转换为同一种基于BEV的互动环境后直接被应用到STPLS3D-Refer上. 此设定测试该模型是否学到了可重复使用的空间搜索策略,而不是数据集特定排序功能. 如表2所示,新场景对所有比较方法都具有挑战性:室内地平面方法对域位移敏感,而当候选分布和视觉统计与City Refer不同时,城市尺度的排名模型会退化. GPT-5.4和Qwen3.6-plus在被连接到Urbex工具环境后表现合理,再次表明强大的VLM推理即使没有任务特定训练也能利用交互式观测. 然而,Urbex在每个报告的准确度度量上都取得了最好的分数. 这些综合结果表明,但本身并不证明,经过RL训练的政策学习了可重复使用的搜索行为,如锚定、缩放、核实和停止。 为了审查转让是否超出指定的地理锚地,我们还对30项经过人工核实的STPLS3D-Refer的无地标再通知进行了评估。 在没有进一步培训的情况下,Urbex在这些表达方式上实现了23.3hit@1,提供了补充证据,证明学到的政策转移到通过视觉属性和地方空间关系表达的询问上. 附录D.3详细介绍了这一评估以及标志性-弹性实验; 图4说明了代理人在新场景中的空间搜索和地平线。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Tables 4 and 4 ablate the tool interface and the reward design. Tool variants add Landmark Query and Oblique Rendering on top of Zoom-in , while reward variants retain terminal IoU and progressively add distance and tool-level shaping terms.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Tool and budget ablation for Urbex.
blocks.zh: 表3:Urbex的工具和预算支出。

blocks.en: The ablation results show that each component contributes a distinct part of the active-search behavior. Without tools, the agent sees the entire downsampled global map but reaches only 10.5 Hit@3 and 2.1 2D IoU, compared with 36.9 and 14.6 using all tools. Adding Zoom-in improves both metrics, confirming that high-resolution local evidence is important for small and densely arranged urban objects. The largest tool gain comes from adding Landmark Query : Hit@3 rises from 15.5 15.5 to 28.2 28.2 , and 2D IoU more than doubles from 4.1 4.1 to 8.9 8.9 . This supports our premise that named buildings, roads, and other geographic anchors are central to city-scale referring expressions. In contrast to indoor scenes where a local crop may already contain most relevant context, city-scale queries often require first locating the correct neighborhood before fine-grained recognition becomes meaningful.
blocks.zh: 衰减结果显示,每个组件都为活性-搜索行为贡献了独特的部分. 没有工具,代理商就会看到整个被下取样的全球地图,但只达到10.5 Hit@3和2.1 2D IoU,而使用所有工具的则只有36.9和14.6. 添加"放大"可以改善两个度量衡,确认高分辨率局部证据对小而密集排列的城市物体很重要. 最大的工具收益来自于添加了"地标查询":Hit@3从15.5 15.5升至28.2 28.2,2D IoU从4.1升至8.9 8.9.9. 这证实了我们的前提,即命名的建筑物、道路和其他地理锚地是城市规模参考表达的核心。 与室内场景相比,当地作物可能已经包含最相关的背景,城市规模的查询往往需要首先找到正确的街区,然后才对精细的识别产生意义。

blocks.en: Oblique Rendering further improves the result by helping the agent verify candidate regions with 3D-aware visual evidence. With all tools enabled, increasing the budget from 7 to 8 turns improves Hit@3 from 34.8 34.8 to 36.9 36.9 and 2D IoU from 11.0 11.0 to 14.6 14.6 , suggesting that one additional interaction is often useful for confirmation before submission. Increasing the budget to 9 turns does not improve Hit@3 and slightly lowers 2D IoU, indicating that excessive interaction can introduce unnecessary exploration or late-stage box adjustments. We therefore use the 8-turn setting as the main configuration, which provides the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off in this ablation. This also suggests that Urbex benefits from a bounded search process rather than unbounded deliberation.
blocks.zh: Oblique Rendering通过帮助代理以3D-意识视觉证据验证候选区域,进一步提高了结果. 由于启用了所有工具,将预算从7个转向8个转弯将Hit@3从34.8 34.8提高到36.9 36.9和2D IoU从11.0 11.0提高到14.6 14.6,这表明在提交之前,增加一次互动往往有助于确认。 将预算提高到9个转弯并不能改善Hit@3,并略微降低2D IoU,表明过度互动可以引入不必要的探索或后期框调整. 因此,我们以8个回合的设定作为主要配置,这为这一缩减提供了最佳的准确效率取舍。 这也表明Urbex受益于一个有界限的搜索程序,而不是无界限的审议。

blocks.en: The reward ablation confirms the same pattern. Terminal IoU alone reaches 22.8 22.8 Hit@3 and 6.7 6.7 2D IoU; adding distance shaping improves them to 30.6 30.6 and 10.9 10.9 , tool-level shaping is also beneficial, and the full reward performs best. Distance shaping is especially useful when early predictions have no overlap with the target, while tool-level rewards make tool use more stable. Their combination shows that localization quality, distance progress, and efficient tool use are complementary.
blocks.zh: 赏金退让证实了同样的模式. 仅IoU号航站楼就达到22.8 22.8 Hit@3和6.7 6.7 2D IoU;加上相距定型可以将其提升到30.6 30.6和10.9 10.9 级,工具级定型也是有益的,全额奖励表现最好. 远程塑造在早期预测与目标没有重叠时特别有用,而工具级奖励则使工具使用更加稳定. 它们的结合表明,本地化的质量、距离进展和高效的工具使用是相辅相成的。

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 分析

blocks.en: We further examine the learned policy using a fixed Landmark Query → \rightarrow Zoom-in → \rightarrow Oblique Rendering → \rightarrow Answer workflow (Appendix D.2 ). In the reported experiments, the base Qwen model reaches only 2.7 Hit@1, whereas RL-trained Urbex reaches 10.0 under the same tool order. The fixed workflow still requires the model to predict tool arguments and the final box. The improvement therefore suggests that training helps the model use the observed scene to make spatial decisions, such as selecting a crop and locating the target within it. The workflow is also useful for a stronger prompted VLM: GPT-5.4 maintains similar Hit@1 while reducing token use from 16,321 to 7,734. This suggests that the learned tool sequence provides an efficient way to organize search, while the trained model contributes to how the tools are used.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步利用固定的地标查询_\正中缩放_\正中缩放_\正中缩放_\正中缩放答题工作流程(附录D.2)来检查学到的政策。 在所报道的实验中,碱基Quen模型仅能达到2.7 Hit@1,而RL训练的Urbex在同一工具顺序下能达到10.0. 固定的工作流程仍然需要模型来预测工具参数和最终的框. 因此,这种改进表明,培训有助于模型利用所观察到的场景作出空间决定,例如选择作物和在其中定位目标。 工作流程对于更强的被激发的VLM也有用:GPT-5.4维持相类似的Hit@1,同时将信使使用从16,321个减少到7,734个. 这表明所学习的工具序列提供了组织搜索的有效方式,而训练有素的模式则有助于工具的使用.

blocks.en: The landmark experiments further show the importance of geographic cues for city-scale search. On CityRefer-NO expressions with named landmarks, the 10 m coordinate-noise setting lowers Hit@1 by only 1.2 points, whereas missing or incorrect landmarks cause drops exceeding ten points (Appendix D.3 ). This suggests that a moderately inaccurate anchor can still guide the search, but losing the reference required by the expression is substantially more harmful. Figure 10 illustrates errors at different stages of this process. In (a), the first zoom excludes the target, and the agent selects another car within the crop. In (b), the zoom contains the target, but the agent selects vehicles in a different parking row. Both predictions remain unchanged after oblique inspection. The first case calls for revisiting the search region, while the second requires closer comparison of nearby instances using the query’s spatial relations. These examples motivate improving both region selection and local verification (Appendix D.6 ).
blocks.zh: 划时代的实验进一步显示了地理提示对城市规模搜索的重要性. 在城市Refer-NO表达式上,有命名地标,10米坐标-噪声设置下方 击出@1只打出1.2分,而缺失或不正确的地标则导致下降超过10分(附录D.3). 这表明中度不准确的主播仍然可以指导搜索,但失去表达需要的引用则有害得多. 图10显示了这一进程不同阶段的错误。 在(a)中,第一个缩放排除了目标,剂在作物内选择了另一辆车. 在(b)中,缩放包含目标,但代理选择不同的停车行. 两种预测在斜视检查后保持不变. 第一个案例要求重新审视搜索区域,而第二个案例则需要利用查询的空间关系,对附近的案例进行更紧密的比较. 这些例子促使改进区域选择和当地核查工作(附录D.6)。

blocks.en: We also examine the quality of the free-form boxes produced by Urbex (Appendix D.5 ). On CityRefer-NO, replacing the original IoU matching rule with positive-overlap filtering or CIoU changes Hit@1 by at most 0.29 points, indicating that target identification is stable under these matching rules. However, additionally requiring the first-ranked target to have BEV IoU ≥ 0.25 \geq 0.25 reduces Hit@1 from 23.53 to 18.71. A prediction can therefore identify the correct candidate while still including substantial surrounding context. The area-ratio statistics show the same issue: the predicted-to-target area ratio has median 1.40 and P90 9.92, indicating that some boxes are considerably larger than the target. These results suggest that refining the box after target selection could further improve localization. We report direct IoU and point F1 alongside Hit@ k k to assess both target identification and the accuracy of the predicted spatial extent.
blocks.zh: 我们还检查了由Urbex(附录D.5.)生产的免费式盒的质量。 在City Refer-NO上,用正重叠过滤或CIoU更改Hit@1替换原来的IoU比对规则,最多为0.29分,表示在这些比对规则下目标识别是稳定的. 然而,另外要求排名第一的目标拥有BEV IoU → 0.25\ geq 0.25将Hit@1从23.53减少到18.71. 因此,预测可以确定正确的候选人,同时仍然包括实质性的周边背景。 地区-比例统计显示同一问题:预测与目标地区比率为中位数1.40和P90 9.92,表明一些框大大大于目标. 这些结果表明,在选择目标后对盒子进行精炼可进一步改善本地化。 我们报告直接IOU和点F1 点击@ kk 以评估目标识别和预测空间范围的准确性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Urbex, an agentic framework for city-scale 3D grounding.
Rather than ranking a large set of precomputed candidates, Urbex formulates grounding as active spatial search in an interactive multi-view environment. We further optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning under a limited interaction budget, encouraging accurate and efficient exploration. Experiments on CityRefer show that Urbex achieves strong grounding accuracy, supports candidate-free localization, and substantially improves online inference efficiency over ranking-based baselines. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further suggest that active spatial search provides a robust alternative to static candidate retrieval for large-scale 3D scene understanding.

urban geometry, appearance, and geography. It is derived from public STPLS3D RealWorld photogrammetry point clouds ( Chen et al., 2022a ) and used only for evaluation. Because STPLS3D lacks CityRefer-style expressions and object
instances, we combine geometric instance extraction, geographic registration, OpenStreetMap landmarks ( OpenStreetMap contributors, 2026 ) , and VLM-assisted expression generation to build a diagnostic, semi-automatic benchmark.

and the number of same-class distractors within 50 m. Table 16 reports the trajectory

Zoom-in region reaches the target area before local disambiguation. Local-disambiguation success measures

less precise cue when an expression describes qualitative spatial relations rather than a metric displacement.
Local-disambiguation success also falls markedly in dense same-class neighborhoods: on ND it drops from 64.7%
without nearby same-class distractors to 25.1% with at least ten. The STPLS3D trend is not monotonic in the first

groups; they do not isolate a causal effect of distance or density, and no bin-level uncertainty is reported.

boundary refinement target different parts of this failure process.

The cache primarily makes RL rollouts efficient and is optional at inference. Rendering oblique views on demand
increases the estimated total to 4.4 s/query, still about 7.3 × 7.3\times faster than CityAnchor’s reported online
latency. The 2.3-hour figure covers oblique-cache construction only, not the complete deployment pipeline:
BEV generation, view-to-world calibration, and landmark registration are additional scene-preparation steps
whose individual construction times are not reported. These costs depend on the scene and are amortized over
queries; neither online ratio should be interpreted as an end-to-end deployment speedup.
blocks.zh:
缓存主要使RL的推出效率高并具有可选推论性. 关于需求的意见
估计总数增至4.4分/平分,仍比CityAnchor在线报道的速度快7.3x7.3分/秒。
长生不老. 2.3小时的数字只包括斜切面的建造,而不是完整的部署管道:
BEV生成,取景到世界校正,地标登记是额外的场景准备步骤.
其个人建筑时间没有报告。 这些成本取决于现场 并被摊还
查询;既不应将在线比率解释为端到端部署速度。

blocks.en:
Urbex depends on a task-specific interactive environment: reliable BEV rendering and view-to-world calibration. Errors in calibration or rendering can project a plausible
2D box to the wrong world location, while absent, ambiguous, outdated, or missing landmarks force the agent to rely
more on visual search and local context, reducing efficiency.
blocks.zh:
Urbex依赖于特定任务的互动环境:可靠的BEV渲染和取景到世界的校正. 校正或渲染错误可以投射出一个合理的
2D框到错误的世界位置,同时缺席,模棱两可,过时或缺失地标迫使特工依赖.
更多关于视觉搜索和本地环境,降低效率.

blocks.en:
The current policy submits a BEV-aligned bounding box, which is efficient and compatible with city-scale search but still
leaves room for improving fine-grained 3D segmentation accuracy. A natural extension is to expose multi-view 3D
instance segmentation models as additional tools, allowing the agent to refine the final prediction from a localized
2D region into a more accurate 3D instance mask or box.
blocks.zh:
目前的政策是提交一个BEV相匹配的边框,这个边框是高效的,与城市规模搜索相兼容的,但仍然
留有余地提高精细的3D分解精度. 一个自然的延伸是曝光多视图 3D
实例分解模型作为补充工具,使该剂能够从本地化
2D区域变为更准确的3D实例口罩或框.

blocks.en:
Beyond beneficial applications such as navigation, urban planning, and accessibility, accurate language-driven
localization at city scale risks misuse for surveillance, persistent target tracking, sensitive-site identification,
or automated monitoring. We mitigate these risks by training only on public benchmarks (CityRefer, STPLS3D) without
personal identifiers, releasing code, checkpoints, and STPLS3D-Refer under a research-only license that prohibits
unconsented surveillance and individual tracking, and recommending privacy-preserving preprocessing (e.g., blurring
faces and license plates) for downstream adaptations.
blocks.zh:
除了导航、城市规划和无障碍等有益应用之外,准确的语言驱动
城市规模的本地化有可能被滥用于监视、持续的目标跟踪、敏感地点识别、
或自动监测。 我们只通过公共基准(CityRefer,STPLS3D)培训来减轻这些风险,没有
个人识别资料、发布代码、检查站和STPLS3D-Refer,只颁发禁止研究许可证
未经同意的监视和个人跟踪,并建议进行保护隐私的预处理(例如模糊)
面相和牌照),用于下游改造.
